title: Sample Aliquoting
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Configure deck and load labware
steps.instruction: Place a 3×5 Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack (slot 1) with the 15 mL insert and load two 15 mL tubes: A1 = solution 1, B1 = solution 2 (each filled to at least the 10 mL mark). Place a 4×6 Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack (slot 2) with the 2 mL insert and load twelve 2 mL tubes (rows A & B for solution 1, rows C & D for solution 2). Load a 1000 µL tip rack in its designated slot.

steps.title: Enter pipette parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol editor, set the mount side for the P1000 GEN2 single‑channel electronic pipette, specify the number of capsules to fill (12), and set the dispense volume per capsule to 300 µL.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Export the generated protocol (e.g., as a .json or .py file) to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, choose “Upload Protocol”, and select the downloaded file.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the tip rack, the 15 mL source tubes, and the 2 mL destination tubes, following the on‑screen prompts.

steps.title: Run the aliquoting protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App. The robot will transfer 300 µL from each 15 mL source tube to the twelve 2 mL destination tubes, with automatic height tracking to prevent the tip from submerging into the source liquid.
